svg.aria-label: Scene::CollectDraws makes the list of DrawItems; PrepareDraws sorts it, writes every item's matrices to the instance buffer, and makes one indirect command per run of equal items and one DrawRun per run of commands with the same material, cull mode and front face. RecordBatches binds the shared vertex and index buffers once, then per DrawRun binds its pipeline and material and issues one vkCmdDrawIndexedIndirect, and Mesh.vert.glsl reads each instance's model matrix by gl_InstanceIndex.
